title: Pushes to a private GitHub organization repo never deploy on a Vercel Hobby account
symptoms: No deployment is created for commits by teammates or bots
The commit status on GitHub suggests transferring the project to a Pro team
cause: Hobby teams cannot deploy private repositories owned by a GitHub organization, GitLab group, or Bitbucket workspace, and only the Hobby owner's own commits deploy. On Pro, the commit author must be a team member linked through Login Connections.
fix: Move the project to a Pro team and add the committers, make the repo personal or public, or deploy from CI with the Vercel CLI and a token.
apply:
vercel pull --yes --environment=production --token=$VERCEL_TOKEN
vercel build --prod --token=$VERCEL_TOKEN
vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --token=$VERCEL_TOKEN
affected: Vercel Hobby teams connected to organization owned private repos; Pro teams with non member commit authors; as of October 2026
